impl.summary: Idol 3D is in Image to 3D -> Splat on both engines. Open engine: oss-idol runs the new image-to-splat-idol graph, a copy of the TripoSplat graph on core nodes with Idol's weights, its reference sampler (50 euler, cfg 4), a photo-crop branch on core nodes behind a switch, and RenderSplat opacity_threshold 0.05. It was built and checked with /prompt on the shared CPU ComfyUI. Cloud engine: the brief's 'no cloud half' was out of date. fal hosts Idol as speridlabs/idol (active since 2026-10-30, $0.10 per generation; schema re-read today from fal's OpenAPI and catalog). Idol's cloud model is idol-3d, labelled 'Idol 3D', with its FieldMap generated from a research record. The studio has Best / Quick look and an 'It's a photo (looser crop)' switch, and its hint line changes with the model. Accounts get 403 own-gpu-tool on both engines, with a test. TripoSplat stays the default on both engines, and its requests are unchanged.

docsNotes: STATUS / FEATURES: Image to 3D -> Splat now offers Idol 3D (Speridlabs, Apache-2.0, Built with DINOv3) on both engines. Open engine: image-to-splat-idol (.spz + orbit video, Best / Quick look, looser crop for photos, 8 GB listed, 1.32 GB of new weights). Cloud engine: fal speridlabs/idol ($0.10, .ply + a point-cloud GLB download). TripoSplat stays the default.

Models & licences: the oss-idol row comes from the manifest licence string (Apache-2.0; TripoSplat architecture MIT attribution; DINOv3 License with the 'Built with DINOv3' notice; FLUX.2 VAE Apache-2.0; BiRefNet MIT). The cloud idol-3d carries a ModelLicence record (Apache-2.0).

Brief out of date: line numbers predate main's 10-30 work. oss-triposplat is at models.ts ~L1870, the spec entry at ~L4409, KNOWN_MODELS TripoSplat rows at ~L360. The studio's hard-coded hint is now the line under the button (~L405). The assist op lists are at tools.ts L99 / L260. MODELS_3D notes were already rewritten as product copy. 'sampler' was already a BINDING_KEY. The TripoSplat spec has no explicit filenamePrefix binding (the builder adds it). The CLOUD RULE 'None' is superseded by fal's speridlabs/idol.

findings.summary: Idol's quality and photo switch live in page state shared across engines, not in per-mode state the way the model pick is, which the brief asked for.
findings.failure_scenario: Someone picks Quick look for Idol on the open engine and then switches to the cloud engine: Quick look carries over to idol-3d. It is harmless, since both engines map it to their own fields, but it does not match the brief. The implementer reports this under 'left'.

findings.summary: takePhoto turns 'It's a photo' off for any library pick, including a person's own earlier upload, which is a real photo. The brief only asked for it to be off for a Fuobe result handed over by ?image= (idol-5).
findings.failure_scenario: Someone uploads a product photo, later picks that same upload from the library in Image to 3D -> Splat with Idol, and gets the tight 'synthetic' crop (fal image_type synthetic / 88:104 false) unless they turn the switch back on. The switch stays visible and labelled, so this is a design nit, not a bug.

findings.summary: Image to 3D still has no STUDIO_ROWS row on the GPU pre-flight board. This was already true on the base for every 3D model and is not a regression. oss-idol does reach workflows/comfyui/requirements.json (core classes, 5 files, vramGb 8, validated) and model-pins.json.
findings.failure_scenario: /connect shows no Image to 3D row for either TripoSplat or Idol, so it is the same as on the base. This needs a separate package, not idol-1.

Cloud route checked at the primary source. fal OpenAPI for speridlabs/idol (fetched today): IdolInput = image_url (required), image_type synthetic|real (default synthetic), num_gaussians 32768-1048576 (default 262144), num_inference_steps 1-50 (default 50), guidance_scale 0-10 (default 3), seed, enable_safety_checker. IdolOutput = model_mesh (.ply), model_glb, preprocessed_image, camera, num_gaussians, seed, timings. The research record in new-models-10.json and the generated idol-3d model (map image_url/seed, sliders, image_type control) match it exactly. The studio sends only num_inference_steps, num_gaussians and image_type, all within the schema's ranges (Quick look is 20 / 65536). It sends no sampler or CFG, and buildPayload passes params.extra through as given (the test asserts the exact payload). fal catalog: speridlabs/idol public, category image-to-3d, dated 2026-10-30T20:19Z. llms.txt: '$0.1 per generations', which matches pricing {usd 0.1, unit request}.

fal tripo3d/triposplat output has no model_glb (re-read today), so the new formats.points in splatOutputs does not change TripoSplat's cloud output. persistArtifacts keeps meta.formats links (LINK_MAPS), so the points GLB is stored locally, not left on fal's CDN. modelToFinish only finishes comfyui image-to-3d, so the .ply / points GLB never reach finish-glb.

HF pins checked at the source: nynxz/Idol @ c718f2b1 idol_fp16 741107210 B sha256 cf452146...; idol_decoder_fp16 576148658 B sha256 c511d99e...; both apache-2.0; speridlabs/idol sha 2731c229 apache-2.0. These match KNOWN_MODELS, model-pins.json, requirements.json and the manifest (0.74 / 0.58 GB).

Graph diffed against image-to-splat-triposplat.json. The only differences are 88:16 idol_fp16, 88:11 idol_decoder_fp16, 88:6 50 / 4.0 / euler / simple, 75 opacity_threshold 0.05, 88:24 image <- 88:104, and the new 88:101 ImageScale 720 lanczos, 88:102 EmptyImage 1024 black, 88:103 ImageCompositeMasked at 152,152 and 88:104 ComfySwitchNode (default false). Everything else is identical, as the brief specified. On the shared ComfyUI, TripoSplatPreprocessImage's description confirms a black background, so the black canvas matches. The manifest bindings (including sampler and photoCrop -> 88:104.switch), outputs, defaults {splatFormat spz, cutout true, photoCrop false}, limits, vramGb 8, customNodes [] and the licence string (with the DINOv3 wording) match the spec, and validation-state has image-to-splat-idol validated.

applied: Review low #1, confirmed and fixed (src/components/model3d/model3d-studio.tsx). Idol's Best / Quick look is now saved per mode and engine (idolQualities keyed `${mode}:${engine}`), the same way the model pick is saved, and it starts on Best. Quick look picked on the open engine no longer carries over to idol-3d on the cloud. The 'It's a photo' switch stays with the picture, because it describes the picture, and the picture is shared across modes and engines.

Review low #2, confirmed and fixed. SlotValue (src/components/studio/media-slot.tsx) has a new optional field, source: 'upload' | 'generation', which LibraryGrid fills from Asset.source (additive; other users of SlotValue are unaffected). The rule for the switch is now a small exported helper, idolPhotoFor(next, prev), in src/lib/av/model3d.ts. An upload or a drop turns the switch on. An earlier upload picked from the library also turns it on, and a result made here turns it off. The same picture again, or an upload's second report, leaves the switch as the person set it. The studio calls this helper from takePhoto.
